gates.evidence: The proposed surface is the Services Tab (s07/Create Account Sheet), which relates to assistant tasks (bookings, shopping, reminders), a standard SFW utility surface.
The reward is '1 task access' granted in-app, with no incentives for clicks, installs, or external rewards.
The proposal uses gain framing: 'Play... to unlock this task', avoiding threats or hostage dynamics.
The proposal includes an offer card with a clear 'Play Now' CTA.
The offer text states: 'Play a quick 15-second game with Luzia to unlock this task.'
The offer includes a 'No thanks' button, and declining simply closes the prompt.
The trigger is a subscription wall (s07) rather than mid-stream chat.
The proposal explicitly limits eligibility to 'Non-paying users hitting the subscription wall'.

scores.evidence: The trigger is the exact moment of need: when a user attempts to start a task and hits the subscription wall.
The ad is placed at the wall boundary, keeping the chat experience uninterrupted and preserving the user's intent.
The reward is capped at 2 accesses per day, and the offer is only shown to non-payers at the wall, preserving the subscription as the superior, unlimited option.
Cost to serve ($0.0009) is roughly 6-10% of the computed revenue per view ($0.009–0.015), providing a healthy margin.
The Services Tab (s06/s07) is identified as a frequent interaction point in the digest (m1, m18).
The proposal maps clearly to SIM-RWD and existing screen s07, making it a low-complexity integration.
Uses app-specific screen s07, character Luzia, and r3 task resource.
Includes explicit caps (2 per day) and a 30-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metrics and guardrails, including a 10% user-level holdout.

parsed.topConcern: None. The proposal is well-reasoned, economically sound, and strictly adheres to policy.
